description:
A softer take on wrestling season gear, blending a delicate bow motif with a nod to the sport's toughest moments. Perfect for the mom who wants cozy and cute, not just bold and sporty.

The vintage collage graphic feels collected, not printed, giving this crewneck a one-of-a-kind, boutique-style look. Great layering piece for chilly gym bleachers all winter long.

A sweet, sturdy way to show up for every meet in comfort and style. Design created by our shop with the help of AI tools and printed on demand by our production partner.
